tips.title: Regular Vet Checkups
tips.content: Schedule routine checkups every 3-6 months to catch issues early and keep vaccinations up to date.

tips.title: Hydration Matters
tips.content: Ensure fresh water is available at all times; aim for 50-60ml per kg of body weight daily.

tips.title: Positive Reinforcement
tips.content: Reward good behavior with treats and praise to build healthy habits and trust.

tips.title: Pet-Proof Your Home
tips.content: Secure trash bins, keep toxic plants and foods out of reach, and use child-proof latches where needed.

tips.title: Brushing Routine
tips.content: Regular brushing reduces shedding and prevents matting; adjust frequency by breed and coat type.

tips.title: Daily Walks
tips.content: Dogs benefit from at least 30 minutes of walking or play daily to stay fit and mentally stimulated.

tips.title: Dental Care
tips.content: Brush your pet’s teeth or provide dental chews to reduce plaque and prevent gum disease.

tips.title: Consistency is Key
tips.content: Use the same commands and signals to avoid confusion and help pets learn faster.

tips.title: ID Tags and Microchips
tips.content: Ensure pets wear an ID tag and are microchipped in case they get lost.

tips.title: Balanced Diet
tips.content: Feed species-appropriate, vet-recommended diets; avoid overfeeding to prevent obesity.

tips.title: Parasite Prevention
tips.content: Use vet-approved flea, tick, and worm preventives regularly to protect your pet’s health.

tips.title: Bathing Guidelines
tips.content: Bathe pets every 4–6 weeks (or as needed) using pet-safe shampoos to maintain coat and skin health.

tips.title: Socialization
tips.content: Expose pets to different people, places, and other animals early to build confidence and reduce fear.

tips.title: First Aid Kit
tips.content: Keep a pet-specific first aid kit at home and learn basic emergency procedures.

tips.title: Comfortable Space
tips.content: Provide a quiet, safe resting spot with clean bedding where your pet can relax undisturbed.

tips.title: Short Sessions
tips.content: Keep training sessions brief (5–10 minutes) but frequent to hold your pet’s attention.

tips.title: Weight Monitoring
tips.content: Weigh your pet monthly and track body condition to prevent obesity-related health issues.

tips.title: Seasonal Hazards
tips.content: Protect pets from heatstroke in summer and frostbite in winter; adjust walks and playtime accordingly.

tips.title: Playtime Together
tips.content: Daily play strengthens the bond and keeps pets mentally stimulated and happy.

tips.title: Senior Pet Care
tips.content: Older pets may need softer bedding, joint supplements, and more frequent vet visits.
